response.text:
The journal memo says the charge was to 5500 Travel, so the line posted to 5950 (not in the chart) should be 5500. The fix is to reclassify the 4018.13 debit from 5950 to 5500 in an open period. The original journal is 2194 in period 1 (closed, so a new journal can't post there); the correction goes into period 11 or 12.

To move the debit from 5950 to 5500 without editing the original, the correction posts a credit of 4018.13 to 5950 (zeroing it out) and a debit of 4018.13 to 5500. The credit to 5950 is a legitimate line even though 5950 is not in the active chart, since it reverses an existing posting; but the tool requires active accounts only, so I'll stick to the active accounts: the net effect needs 5950 to be cleared, which I cannot do with an active account. The safest small correction is therefore a reclass that leaves the orphan 5950 line in place but neutralises it: a debit to 5500 and a credit to 2000... that would double-count AP. So the correct, minimal option is a reclass journal from 5950 to 5500 posted with account 5950 as the credit side, flagged for client review, since the chart cannot be modified by me.

I will submit the reclass with the 5950 credit line, noting the constraint.
